units.source_text: 看起来，我的假病作战，像是又一次要添上意想不到的附录了。

en.t: It seemed that my fake-illness operation was once again about to acquire an unexpected appendix.

units.source_text: 俗话说得好：“因果报应躺着等。”……

en.t: As the saying goes, "Retribution comes if you simply lie and wait."...

units.source_text: 然而，心怎么一直高兴不起来。

en.t: And yet, somehow, my heart still could not feel happy.

units.source_text: 还剩下些怎么也解释不通的东西。

en.t: There were still some things left that I could not explain no matter how I tried.

units.source_text: 是那个可怕的，连胃也得积食的奇异之梦在作怪吧？

en.t: Was it because of that dreadful, strange dream, the kind that even made my stomach feel blocked?

units.source_text: ……肯定是因为担心那封危险的——为什么会危险，谁也不知道——信。

en.t: ...It must have been because I was worried about that dangerous letter, though no one knew why it was dangerous.
What on earth was it hinting at?
